articles.title: Beijing says US, China to pursue military crisis-communication pact
articles.summary: China and the United States are set to establish a military crisis-communication pact, a significant breakthrough that could enhance stability and prevent dangerous encounters in the Indo-Pacific region amidst rising tensions. This agreement reflects a crucial step toward improved military dialogue and risk management between the two superpowers.

articles.title: Why US chip controls took a back seat at the Xi-Trump summit
articles.summary: The recent summit between Xi Jinping and Donald Trump highlighted the pivotal role of US semiconductor leaders Nvidia and AMD in navigating the complex landscape of chip controls, underscoring the critical need for access to the Chinese market amidst rising geopolitical tensions. This breakthrough is essential as it could reshape global supply chains and influence the future of technology competition between the US and China.
